title: Northgate Tire Center Tread Inspection Standard — Tread Depth Reduction on Treadwear Credits
content:
# Tread depth reduction on treadwear credits

**Standard.** A Northgate Tire Center treadwear credit carries a tread factor read from the remaining tread measured, in 32nds of an inch, on the claim entry — the most recent treadwear claim entry recorded on the package:

| Tread measured on the claim entry | Tread factor |
|---|---|
| 0/32 inch or less | 0.8 |
| above 0/32 and below the package's treadwear claim tread depth (2/32 inch on every Northgate Tire Center package) | 0.9 |
| 2/32 inch or more | 1 — no reduction |

**How the factor acts.** The prorated treadwear amount — the price per tire multiplied by the treadwear remaining mileage share — is multiplied by the tread factor. The factor acts on the unrounded amount, and the credit is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Each measurement, read against the standard

- A tire worn to 0/32 inch takes 0.8.
- A tire measured at 1/32 inch is above 0/32 and below 2/32 inch, and takes 0.9.
- A tire measured at exactly 2/32 inch is at the claim depth, and takes 1.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A prorated treadwear amount of $50.00 on a tire measured at 1/32 inch is multiplied by 0.9, giving $45.00; at 0/32 inch it is multiplied by 0.8, giving $40.00.
